sections.label: Bus depot near Tampines Road
sections.summary: Work on a bus depot in the forest between Tampines Road and Buangkok East Drive began months ago, upsetting residents living under 200 metres away.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: Works to develop a bus depot in the middle of the part of the forest between Tampines Road and Buangkok East Drive began a few months ago to the chagrin of my residents living less than 200 metres away, including residents at Kingsford Waterbay Condominium.

sections.label: No EIA for bus depot
sections.summary: MND's November 2025 reply showed no environmental impact assessment or biodiversity study was required, as the site is classified brownfield regrowth scrubland.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: The most striking policy issue here is the lack of transparency in the process of assessing the site's current value and whether the process can be further enhanced.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: It is clear from the response to my Parliamentary Question in November 2025 by MND, that no environmental impact assessment (EIA) or baseline biodiversity study was required before the Government decided on and commence the bus depot construction.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: The justification given for this exemption is that the site is classified as a brownfield site, comprising primarily young regrowth scrubland.

sections.label: Brownfield label exempts environmental studies
sections.summary: The brownfield label gave permanent exemption from environmental impact assessment or baseline biodiversity study, regardless of the vegetation's age and density.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: Thus, the mere fact that the site was once developed, stripped a current mature forest of its ecological and social worth.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: Thus, the label "brownfield" gave us a permanent exemption from the duty to conduct an EIA or a baseline biodiversity study, regardless of the vegetation's age and density.

sections.label: Road and housing land percentages
sections.summary: Roads occupy 12% of land, unchanged for a decade, while public housing occupies 8% yet serves nearly 80% of 1.46 million resident households.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: For example, Singapore's road network occupies 12% of our total land area today, remaining at the same percentage for the past decade, even though car ownership per household has declined and is estimated to serve 481,000 households.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: At the same time, public housing occupies only 8% of land take per data from a 2019 Parliamentary response, yet serves more households, and nearly 80% of the 1.46 million resident household in Singapore.

sections.label: Review land-hungry systems
sections.summary: The member urges the Government to review whether land-hungry systems can reduce usage or go underground or above ground instead of clearing greenery.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: The policy question I urge the Government to review is, are we prepared to more aggressively review and make difficult decisions for land hungry systems, either by reducing usage or going underground or above ground, rather than repeatedly clearing the remaining greenery?

sections.label: Higher threshold for clearing greenery
sections.summary: Clearing green spaces should face a higher justification threshold than reversible land uses while alternatives such as co-location or intensification exist.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: The clearing of green spaces should be subjected to a higher justification threshold than land uses that can be undone for as long as alternatives exist, whether through co-location, going underground, intensifying existing sites, or reconfiguring underutilised land.

sections.label: Mandatory vegetated site functional assessment
sections.summary: Any vegetated site above a certain maturity or size must undergo a mandatory functional assessment of its current role, regardless of zoning history.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: Any vegetated site above a certain maturity or size must undergo a mandatory functional assessment, regardless of its zoning history to determine its current role in heat mitigation, flood absorption and ecological connectivity and preservation.

sections.label: Avoidance and minimisation before mitigation
sections.summary: Agencies must demonstrate avoidance and minimisation were explored before mitigation, and no reason was given for not shifting the bus depot.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: Agencies must clearly demonstrate that avoidance and minimisation were explored before mitigation is proposed, specifically when my residents appealed to the Land Transport Authority (LTA) or MND for the bus depot site to be shifted to the current heavy vehicle park along Tampines Road.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: Other than mitigation measures, no reason has yet been given for not agreeing to the shift, nor was there any reason given to justify why the bus depot had to be sited in the middle of the forested area between Buangkok East Drive and Tampines Road.

sections.label: Relocating bus depot, retaining green lung
sections.summary: A request to review relocating the bus depot to Tampines Road heavy vehicle park and retain as much of the green lung as possible.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: Please review and consider relocating the bus depot to the heavy vehicle park at Tampines Road, and please consider retaining as much as possible of this vital green lung of the north east, which is home to one of the largest collection of birds, including conservation status birds in Singapore, stretching from Tampines Road to Pasir Ris Industrial Drive 1, for the benefit of residents living in the north east and all Singaporeans.

sections.label: Long-term careful land use planning
sections.summary: The Government takes a long-term, careful approach to using limited land, balancing competing needs including green spaces, education, transport, defence and recreation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: The Government takes a long-term and very careful approach when planning how we use our limited land to support the diverse needs and aspirations of generations of Singaporeans, and we are balancing many competing needs, including the need for green spaces, education, transport, defence, recreation and many more that the Member has outlined.

sections.label: Safeguarded green spaces and nature reserves
sections.summary: More than 7,800 hectares of green spaces have been safeguarded, including four nature reserves with sensitive and biodiverse habitats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: Today, we have safeguarded more than 7,800 hectares of green spaces for our nature reserves, nature parks and other green spaces, such as parks and park connectors, and these include our four nature reserves, which contain some of our most sensitive and biodiverse habitats.

sections.label: Park within 10-minute walk by 2030
sections.summary: By 2030, every household will be within a 10-minute walk of a park.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: By 2030, every household will be within a 10-minute walk of a park.

sections.label: Restoring habitats and nature ways
sections.summary: By 2030, the aim is to restore and enhance 80 hectares of forest, marine and coastal habitats and establish 300 kilometres of nature ways.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: By 2030, we aim to restore and enhance 80 hectares of forest, marine and coastal habitats as well as to establish 300 kilometres of nature ways.

sections.label: Bus depot rezoning and briefing
sections.summary: MPs were briefed in February 2018, and on 1 December 2023 a Gazette Notice was published for rezoning to B2 for a bus depot intended to improve public transport services.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: In fact, the Members of Parliament were briefed in February 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: And on 1 December 2023, a Gazette Notice was published for rezoning to B2 to transport facilities for this bus depot.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: The site is intended to be progressively developed to help us to achieve a few objectives.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: The planned bus depot, which the Member raised, at the southern part of this area is intended to improve public transport services for residents.

sections.label: Measures during bus depot construction
sections.summary: LTA has agreed to put in place necessary measures during construction to mitigate environmental impact and disamenities to residents.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: Nevertheless, to mitigate any environmental impact and disamenities to residents, LTA has agreed to put in place necessary measures during the construction.

sections.label: Planning greenery and recreational spaces
sections.summary: Agencies will continue to carefully plan for the provision of greenery and recreational spaces in the area.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Agencies will continue to carefully plan for the provision of greenery and recreational spaces in the area.

sections.label: Trade-offs and repurposing land
sections.summary: Survival and present quality of life result from deliberate, often difficult, trade-offs, with land built upwards and downwards and constantly repurposed for evolving uses.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Our survival and present quality of life are the result of deliberate, often difficult, trade-offs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: We build upwards and downwards and constantly repurpose our land for evolving uses.
